svg.title: Time to get a store up
svg.desc: Ben Sehl said that 12 years ago, even knowing how to code, it took him two weeks to get a rough Kotn store working, and that a fully custom store now takes about twenty minutes with Canvas.

g.font-family: Pretendard, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif
g.text: Time to get a store up
As told by Shopify Director of Product Ben Sehl · not a like-for-like measurement
Source: Shopify's Canvas announcement (Oct 1, 2026), as quoted by TechCrunch. Two weeks counted as 14 calendar days (20,160 min).
